most_similar_reason: Candidate 9 shows the same distinctive subject: a tall free-standing anthropomorphic pillar whose flat faces carry low-relief schematic arms, hands and body ornaments treated as a single stylized body rather than a scene.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 1 depicts pecked/painted rock-art of boats and tiny stick-figures with weapons scattered on an open rock surface, sharing neither the single monumental anthropomorphic body nor its relief-carved arms, belt and disc ornaments.
